serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Good day to you Mrs.
Mrs. Fisher: What’s up, kid. I see that you are still wetting a line. 
You: What?
Mrs. Fisher: Just forget it, kid. Rookies these days…
You: Anyway, I have some questions for you.
Mrs. Fisher: Fire away.
You: What if I catch too many fishes? It would be a waste to throw them out.
Mrs. Fisher: If you catch a really nice one I will buy it off your hands.
You: Really? Would that be ok with you?
Mrs. Fisher: Sure. I know a guy or two that would gladly buy a dozen or so of fresh fish.
You: That’s great!
Mrs. Fisher: You can always find me here between 5am and 4pm.
You: I will try not to forget.
Mrs. Fisher: Anyway kid, what do you want to do next?
